content:
Andre Platzer made compelling arguments for the utility of differential dynamic logic for modeling cyber-physical systems. I'm aware that there are multiple implementations of this logic in PVS:
https://github.com/nasa/pvslib/tree/master/dL
and in the Scala-based Keymera theorem prover:
https://github.com/LS-Lab/KeYmaeraX-release/tree/master"

Has anyone ported this logic to Lean already?
If not, is there anyone interested in collaborating on this?

  • Nicolas.

I’m also interested in this. KeYmaeraX was my first theorem prover, but I left after I needed some geometric series and exp() functions. I don’t have any people to put on the project, but would be interested in staying in touch!
